cohort: Seven pregnant women infected with SARS-CoV-2 who gave birth between July 1st and November 30th, 2020
finding: In a small case series of pregnant women infected with SARS-CoV-2, there were no maternal deaths, no cases of vertical transmission, and all newborns had good Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Applying cesarean section as a method of birth did not influence vertical transmission.
